WITH telescope_weather_stats AS (
    SELECT
        t.telescregistry,
        o.weathprofile,
        AVG(s.modindex) as avg_modindex,
        AVG(s.phaseshiftdeg) as avg_phaseshift
    FROM signals s
    INNER JOIN telescopes t ON s.telescref = t.telescregistry
    INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation
    GROUP BY t.telescregistry, o.weathprofile
),
baseline_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(avg_modindex) as mean_modindex
    FROM telescope_weather_stats
),
filtered_groups AS (
    SELECT
        tws.telescregistry,
        tws.weathprofile,
        tws.avg_modindex,
        tws.avg_phaseshift,
        bm.mean_modindex
    FROM telescope_weather_stats tws
    CROSS JOIN baseline_mean bm
    WHERE tws.avg_modindex > bm.mean_modindex
)
SELECT
    fg.weathprofile,
    AVG(fg.avg_modindex) as avg_modindex_kept,
    AVG(fg.avg_phaseshift) as avg_phaseshift_kept,
    AVG(fg.avg_modindex - fg.mean_modindex) as avg_amount_above_baseline
FROM filtered_groups fg
GROUP BY fg.weathprofile
ORDER BY fg.weathprofile

assumptions.assumption: Signals without matching telescope or observatory records are excluded via INNER JOINs (matching the 'dropping signals that don't match' requirement).
Each (telescope, weather_profile) group's averages are computed as simple arithmetic means over all signals in that group.
The threshold baseline is a simple arithmetic mean of all group-level averages, where each group counts equally regardless of signal count.
Strict inequality ('>') is used for filtering; groups with average modulation index exactly equal to the baseline mean are excluded.
